OAuth2.AuthorizeIntro: %s is requesting access to your Matomo account.
OAuth2.AuthorizeTextTitle: is requesting access to your Matomo account
OAuth2.AuthorizeHelpText: You can revoke access at any time from your Matomo account settings.
OAuth2.AdminNoClients: No clients configured yet, click the "Create Client" button to create an OAuth 2.0 client.
OAuth2.AdminNameHelp: Displayed to users when they authorise the application and in the OAuth client list.
OAuth2.AdminDescriptionHelp: Optional description that explains what this client is used for.
OAuth2.AdminTypeHelp: Choose %1$sConfidential%2$s for server-side applications that can securely store a client secret, and %1$sPublic%2$s for applications that cannot safely store secrets.
OAuth2.AdminGrantTypesHelp: Select the OAuth authentication methods this client can use to obtain access tokens from Matomo.
OAuth2.AdminScopeHelp: Scope defines the maximum access level granted to the OAuth token. For example, if the %1$sadmin%2$s scope is used, the token will have admin-level access at most, even if the authenticated user is a superuser.
OAuth2.AdminRedirectUrisHelp: Allowed redirect or callback URIs for the authorisation code flow (one per line, must match exactly).
OAuth2.AdminActiveHelp: Disable to block the client from authenticating without deleting it.
OAuth2.AdminSecretHelp: Copy now; it will not be shown again.
OAuth2.AdminRotatedNotification: The client secret has been rotated successfully. Copy the new secret now, as it is only shown once. If you lose access you can rotate the secret again, and your current secret will be invalidated.
OAuth2.AdminRotateConfirm: Are you sure you want to rotate the secret for client %s?
OAuth2.AdminPauseConfirm: Are you sure you want to pause client %s?
OAuth2.AdminResumeConfirm: Are you sure you want to resume client %s?
OAuth2.AdminDeleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete client %s?
OAuth2.AdminClientsDescriptions: OAuth clients allow external applications to securely access Matomo data on behalf of a user. Create and manage clients here to integrate Matomo with your own systems or third-party tools.
OAuth2.AdminClientDescriptionAdditionalHelpText: To authenticate and securely access your Matomo data, you may need the Auth URL %1$s and Token URL %2$s.
OAuth2.ClientSecretHelp: Copy the client secret now, it will not be shown again.
OAuth2.ClientSecretVisibleHelp: Use this secret to authenticate the client securely. It is only shown in full when it is created or rotated.
OAuth2.ClientSecretMaskedHelp: This secret is hidden after it is created or rotated. If you did not copy it, rotate the secret to generate a new one.
OAuth2.ClientCredentialsExceptionPublicClient: Public clients cannot use the client_credentials grant type
OAuth2.ClientIdException: clientId must be a 32 character hexadecimal string
OAuth2.EncryptionKeyNotConfigured: OAuth 2.0 encryption key is not configured.
OAuth2.InvalidClientScope: Invalid scope, check the scope mapped to the requested client.
OAuth2.InvalidClientToRotateSecretExceptionMess: Invalid client, please check your client type.
OAuth2.SystemSettingOAuthAccessTokenLifetimeDes: Define how long an access token remains valid after it is issued.
OAuth2.SystemSettingOAuthRefreshTokenLifetimeDe: Define how long a refresh token remains valid. While valid, the client can use it to obtain new access tokens.
OAuth2.SystemSettingOAuthAuthorizationCodeLifet: Define how long the temporary authorisation code remains valid during the OAuth authorisation process.
OAuth2.SystemSettingOAuthScopeDescription: Defines which scopes OAuth clients can request. Removing a scope here disables it for all OAuth clients globally.
OAuth2.InvalidValueException: Invalid value, it should be greater than 0.
OAuth2.InvalidNumericValueException: Invalid value, it should be a numeric value, greater than 0.
